node.statement: Put R=L_U^{-1}(J). Then U bold-dot R=J and ||R||<=3. Exact unitality and U^dagger bold-dot U=J give U^dagger=U^dagger bold-dot(U bold-dot R) and R=(U^dagger bold-dot U) bold-dot R. Hence the associator bound gives ||U^dagger-R||<=e||U||^2||R||<=12e. Therefore ||U bold-dot U^dagger-J||=||U bold-dot(U^dagger-R)||<=(1+e)||U||*12e<=(65/64)*2*12e<=25e.
